content:
Hi all,

The AI for Math Fund Team at Renaissance Philanthropy is hiring a Technical Associate. We're interested in candidates with strong mathematical and technical backgrounds in the AI for Math space, especially recent math/CS PhDs who are collaborative, proactive, and excited to help build the field.

The full job posting is HERE.

The role includes:

  • Assessing technical grant proposals in AI for Math and formal verification
  • Building and evaluating systems to support program operations 
  • Supporting backend automations and strategic analyses
  • Helping design and run field-building efforts and other ecosystem-building activities
  • Engaging with researchers and representing the program at technical venues

Please share with anyone who may be a good fit.

Best,

AI for Math Team
Renaissance Philanthropy
